People still don’t fully understand how insane Starship’s long-term goal actually is.

SpaceX wants to launch over 10,000 Starships per year.

That’s more than one launch every hour carrying potentially over 200 metric tons to orbit each time.

At that scale humanity would move more than 2 million metric tons into orbit every single year.

For perspective that’s roughly equal to launching around 4,500 International Space Stations annually.

This is no longer about rockets.

This is about building the transportation system for an entirely new era of civilization.
